Calculates the basic statistics of a raster: minimum, maximum, mean, standard deviation, range and sum of the values, and optionally their histogram.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Statistics, Raster, Histogram<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterSummary`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to analyze. |
| `pBins` | int |  | `100` | The number of bins of the histogram. |
| `doHistogram` | boolean |  | `false` | Also compute the histogram. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMin` | Double |  | The minimum value. |
| `outMax` | Double |  | The maximum value. |
| `outMean` | Double |  | The mean value. |
| `outSdev` | Double |  | The standard deviation of the values. |
| `outRange` | Double |  | The range of the values, maximum minus minimum. |
| `outSum` | Double |  | The sum of the values. |
| `outCb` | double[][] |  | The histogram, as rows of bin center value and number of cells. |
